text: The initiative utilizes a National Resilience Tool to prioritize risks from 'low to critical,' ensuring efficient allocation of resources. It streamlines local road funding through Regional Land Transport Plans (RLTPs) to reduce the burden on councils. The program emphasizes a balanced approach, incorporating both green and grey infrastructure, and focuses on access-critical low-volume roads and freight lifelines.

metadata.solution_name: State highway and local roads recovery funding (Budget 2024)
